shots.name: ask-message-typed
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff === 'pending' && document.body.innerText.includes('Is adding 12,500 tokens enough to finish, or should I stop here?') && !document.body.textContent.includes('[Plan paused]') && !document.body.textContent.includes('<user-question>')

shots.name: ask-message-blank
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff === 'pending' && document.body.innerText.includes('What should I do about this paused plan?') && !document.body.textContent.includes('[Plan paused]')

shots.name: failed-unknown-reason
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'failed' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').textContent.includes("The plan couldn't be created.") && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block] [role=alert] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Report bug|Diagnose with the assistant'

shots.name: failed-known-reason
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'failed' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').textContent.includes('The saved plan file is not valid JSON') && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block] [role=alert] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Report bug|Diagnose with the assistant'

shots.name: paused-progress-not-saved
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]'); if(!b||b.dataset.planStatus!=='paused') return false; const r=b.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-paused-reason]'); const a=b.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-pause-actions]'); if(!r||!a) return false; const names=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim()).join('|'); const rr=r.getBoundingClientRect(), ar=a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.textContent === "Paused — the plan stopped because its progress couldn't be saved." && document.body.innerText.includes('paused — something went wrong') && !document.body.innerText.includes('reached its limit') && names==='Report bug|Ask the assistant|Stop|Continue' && !b.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-paused-report]') && !b.textContent.includes('Something went wrong') && !b.textContent.includes('Add budget') && !b.textContent.includes('EIO') && ar.top < rr.bottom && ar.left > rr.left;})()
